features.description:
herdr oversight runbook. Lets the lead answer "what is every agent doing, and what did it last say?" and reach an agent, using only existing tools (herdr, jq), with no new scripts, mise tasks, skills or agents. Lives in the existing dash-skogai/type/tool/herdr.md (which already holds herdr gotchas); dash-skogai/README.md is regenerated with `mise run dash:graph`, never hand-edited. Scope is Claude agents (kind `claude`) running under herdr; other agent kinds get one UNKNOWN line. Out of scope: Claude Code's built-in ListAgents/SendMessage (skogix 2026-11-06: use herdr for messaging).
Acceptance criteria:
1. herdr.md has an oversight section that names, for each question, the exact existing command that answers it:
   a. all agents with pane, cwd, state and task title: `herdr agent list` (or `herdr api snapshot`);
   b. recent output of one agent: `herdr agent read <target> --source recent-unwrapped`;
   c. wait for a state change: `herdr agent wait <target> --timeout <ms>`; notify skogix: `herdr notification show`;
   d. full last answer: the transcript path `~/.claude/projects/<cwd-slug>/<agent_session.value>.jsonl` with the rule that derives <cwd-slug> from the agent's cwd, and a jq expression that prints the last assistant entry that has text content (tool_use-only entries skipped);
   e. send text to an agent: `herdr pane send-text <pane> <text>` + `herdr pane send-keys <pane> enter` (the tmux-style primitive) and `herdr agent prompt <agent> <text> --wait --timeout <ms>` (the default for agents), with why the latter is the default: bracketed paste with Enter in one submission, refuses with agent_blocked at an approval dialog, confirms activity and waits.
2. Every command in 1a-1d was run live from inside herdr (HERDR_ENV=1), read-only, against agents running on the verification day; `herdr agent wait` was run with `--timeout 30000`. Raw outputs are saved under tmp/f001/ (gitignored) and herdr.md records the herdr version and verification date. The jq expression in 1d returns the last text answer of at least one live agent whose agent_session is set.
3. Commands in 1e were exercised only against a throwaway claude agent the implementer started for that purpose in a new pane (closed afterwards); no prompt, text or keys are sent to any pre-existing agent or pane.
4. The case where `agent_session` is null (seen 2026-11-06 on w88:p2) is documented: either the cause (lead: `herdr pane report-agent --agent-session-id` is what sets it) and a way to find that agent's transcript, or an UNKNOWN entry stating what was checked.
5. If a command named in 1 does not exist or behaves differently live, the runbook documents what actually works and the difference is listed in the feature's approaches_tried; this is not a failure.
6. Changed files are only dash-skogai/type/tool/herdr.md, the regenerated dash-skogai/README.md, one pointer line to herdr.md in the Layout section of /home/skogix/skogai/CLAUDE.md, and F001's own bookkeeping fields in .harness/features.json (status, approaches_tried, proof, test_file, correction_cycles, scope_expansions, failure_reason). No other new or changed files (tmp/ excluded).
7. `mise run dash:graph` regenerates dash-skogai/README.md and the regenerated README contains the herdr tool's section. `yq --front-matter=extract '.type + " " + .title' dash-skogai/type/tool/herdr.md` prints `tool herdr`. (`mise run dash:check` is not used: it takes a dot directory, defaults to `src`, and does not cover files under type/.)
8. If no claude agent with agent_session set is running on the verification day, F001 is set to blocked rather than verified against fakes.
9. Manual journey check (skogix): in a fresh Claude session in ~/skogai, skogix asks "what are the herdr agents doing?"; the session answers per agent (state, task title, last text answer) in at most 3 tool calls, and the answer matches a `herdr agent list` skogix runs at the same moment.
features.notes: skogix 2026-11-06: first feature after reset; lesson from the removed orchestrate skill (31c1a85): use existing tools, do not write own scripts
approaches_tried: AC1-AC8 verified live 2026-11-06 (herdr 0.9.5); raw outputs in tmp/f001/
deviation (AC5): transcripts are under $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects (/skogai/claude), not ~/.claude/projects as the spec and old gotcha said
deviation (AC5): herdr agent read prints plain text, not json

deviation (AC5): a claude started under ~/skogai blocks on the external CLAUDE.md imports dialog; agent start returns agent_not_ready, and a plain agent wait then returns at once on the stale blocked state, so wait --until idle --until done
AC4: null agent_session traced to the claude integration hook reporting only on SessionStart; likely cause for w88:p2, unconfirmed
AC3: prompt and send-text/send-keys exercised only on throwaway agent f001-scratch (haiku, pane w88:p6, closed); agent prompt confirmed to refuse with agent_blocked

proof.claim: herdr.md oversight section answers what every claude agent is doing and last said using existing herdr/jq commands
proof.not_established: AC9 accepted on skogix's report 2026-11-06 ("it worked out as you expected"); the journey pane w88:p7 showed no question and no transcript was found, so there is no recorded artifact of the run. null agent_session cause unconfirmed; non-claude agents not checked

features.description:
herdr-orchestration skill, proven live. Makes the existing skill .skogai/skills/herdr-orchestration/ (reached via the .claude/skills -> .skogai/skills symlink; SKILL.md, references/plan-mode.md, agents/openai.yaml; currently untracked) tracked and true for herdr 0.9.5, by using it for one real orchestration: this Claude session is the controller, one claude worker and one codex worker fix the repo's shfmt lint debt in parallel on disjoint files. No new scripts, mise tasks, skills or agents (skogix 2026-11-06: use existing tools). Plan-first delegation (references/plan-mode.md) is out of scope (F003); the file is committed unchanged except for edits AC6 forces.
The real task: `hk check --all` fails only on shfmt (shellcheck passes) for exactly 15 files on 2026-11-06. One of them, .skogai/skills/orchestrate/bin/herdr-workspaces, is the last leftover of the orchestrate skill removed in 31c1a85; skogix 2026-11-06: delete it (and the empty .skogai/skills/orchestrate/ directory) in its own commit before the run, leaving these 14. Claude worker (agent name fmt-repo, tab label `claude: fmt repo`): .harness/init.sh, .skogai/scripts/check-claude-usage.sh, .skogai/scripts/claude-code-documentation.sh, .skogai/scripts/claude/cloud-environment.sh, .skogai/scripts/date.sh, .skogai/scripts/get-project-name.sh, .skogai/scripts/search.sh, .skogai/scripts/whereami.sh. Codex worker (agent name fmt-dash, tab label `codex: fmt dash`): dash-skogai/Argcfile.sh, dash-skogai/bin/skogai-config, dash-skogai/tmp/graph/types.sh, dash-skogai/tmp/routing/scripts/list-xml-tags.sh, dash-skogai/tmp/routing/scripts/parse-frontmatter.sh, dash-skogai/tmp/routing/scripts/validate-schema.sh. Each worker fixes only formatting (shfmt -i 2 -ci, as hk.pkl configures it) in its own files, edits nothing else, does not commit, and reports changed files plus the commands it ran and their results.
Acceptance criteria:
0. QA binding: manual (evidence_type manual: live command output, packets and registry under tmp/f002/, as in F001).
1. The skill directory is committed to git as-is (its own commit, before any edit to it) so later edits show as diffs.
2. Preflight from SKILL.md (herdr status, integration status, pane current --current, agent list) is run from inside herdr (HERDR_ENV=1) before launch; claude and codex integrations show current. Raw output saved under tmp/f002/ (gitignored).
3. Both workers are launched exactly as SKILL.md "launch workers" says: tab create --label ... --no-focus in the caller workspace, then agent start <name> --kind claude|codex --pane <root_pane_id> with the delegation packet as launch argv (claude: --permission-mode auto; codex: --approve-for-me; skogix 2026-11-06 amendment: auto mode for both instead of bypass flags, after the controller's auto-mode classifier refused a --dangerously-skip-permissions launch). Each packet contains every item listed in SKILL.md "delegation packets". Packets are saved under tmp/f002/.
4. The controller tracks both workers only with SKILL.md "track workers" verbs (agent wait --until ... --timeout in check-ins of at most 300000 ms, agent read --source recent-unwrapped) and keeps the registry SKILL.md describes in tmp/f002/registry.md, through final disposition.
5. Verification by the controller, taken after both workers report and before the controller edits SKILL.md or any bookkeeping file: `git diff --name-only HEAD` shows changes only in the 14 files above; each file's diff is whitespace/formatting only (`git diff -w --ignore-blank-lines` on those files is empty, or every remaining hunk is listed and justified in approaches_tried); `hk check --all` exits 0; `.harness/init.sh smoke_test` passes; `bash -n` passes on every changed file. The formatting fixes are committed separately from skill edits.
6. Every place where live behavior differs from SKILL.md (a flag, an output shape, a wait that misfires, the external CLAUDE.md imports dialog that blocks a claude started under ~/skogai as seen in F001, a hook that blocks a worker, anything a worker could not do unattended) is fixed in SKILL.md so the next controller would not hit it, and each difference is listed in F002's approaches_tried. If nothing differs, approaches_tried says so.
7. On the passing path, both workers are retired per SKILL.md "retire workers" (tab close) after their disposition is recorded; at the end `herdr agent list` shows neither fmt-repo nor fmt-dash.
8. Changed files are only: the 14 files above, the deletion of .skogai/skills/orchestrate/bin/herdr-workspaces, files under .skogai/skills/herdr-orchestration/ (SKILL.md for AC6; plan-mode.md only if AC6 requires), and F002's own bookkeeping in .harness/features.json plus the usual harness session files (.harness/claude-progress.txt, .harness/context_summary.md, .harness/mld/). tmp/ excluded.
9. If a worker cannot be started or gets stuck on a stop condition from SKILL.md "stop conditions", the controller stops and reports per the skill instead of doing the worker's edits itself; F002 is then set to blocked with failure_reason, not passing; a stuck worker's tab may stay open as evidence, with the reason recorded in the registry (AC7 does not apply on this path).
11. External CLAUDE.md imports dialog: if a claude worker started with herdr agent start stops on it (agent_not_ready, as in F001), the controller does not answer it; it sends `herdr notification show` to skogix, who approves it manually in the worker's pane, and then the controller re-enters the wait (agent wait --until idle --until done, since a plain wait returns at once on the stale blocked state per F001). This is not an AC9 failure. SKILL.md documents the case and that approval persists via hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesApproved in $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json.
10. Manual check (skogix): reading tmp/f002/registry.md and the herdr tab bar during or after the run, skogix can tell which model did which slice and what each worker reported.
